dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extents in Betroka district, Anosy region, Madagascar as of 9 February 2022
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20220201MDG** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters over Betroka district, Anosy region, Madagascar observed from Sentinel-2 image acquired on 9 February 2022 at 10:00 local time. Within the analyzed cloud free zones of about ~1,000 km2, a total of about 35 km2 of lands appear to be flooded. Based on Worldpop population data and the detected surface waters, about 2,000 people are potentially exposed or living close to flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis that has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
